title: 第八章 火爆的销售额
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
不出所料，所有人一进店，顿时哗啦啦全聚到了宠物展示区其中一只仓鼠的笼子前。
而被他们围住的主角，当然就是昨天在视频里亮过相的小仓鼠十七。
“这就是昨天视频里那只仓鼠吧！”
“肯定是，这毛色我都记着呢。”
“小仓鼠，做个俯卧撑呗！”
有人迫不及待的发出了指令。
小仓鼠听到指令，不情不愿的将两只前腿趴在笼边，身体下压，做了个不太标准的俯卧撑动作。
这积极性可比昨天拍视频的时候差多了，不过即便如此，也立即引发了各种尖叫。
“哇，真的和视频里一样，能够听懂人话啊！”
“这也太萌了吧！”
“小仓鼠，去跑几圈！”
“翻个跟斗看看！”
“躺下装死！”
随后众人顿时叽叽喳喳的又开始提各种其他命令。
结果仓鼠却是不闻不问，只管趴在笼边，伸出爪子做出讨要的动作。
众人一开始看得有些疑惑，
直到有人意识到了什么，尝试着往它手里塞了颗花生，小仓鼠果断将花生塞进腮帮里，这才继续执行了跑轮的命令，
众人恍然大悟，原来是讨要吃的，才肯做下一个指令！
不过这种势力的行为非但没有惹人生厌，反倒更加抓住了在场一众女性的心：还知道讨要回报，这妥妥是聪明的象征啊！
“太可人了吧！”

“感觉比视频里还聪明呐！”
“怎么会有这么可爱的仓鼠！”
“老板，这只仓鼠怎么卖？”
众人纷纷夸赞着，很快就有人坚持不住了。
一个上班族打扮的女人率先朝沐游询问起了价格。
“抱歉，这只仓鼠不卖，不过你可以买展示区里的其他几只仓鼠，它们也都经过了训练，和十七一样，能够听懂大部分的命令。”沐游说。
十七作为昨天视频中的主角，很有成为网红的潜质，沐游当然不会傻到直接卖掉它，把他留在店里当个招牌显然更合适。
“那其他仓鼠怎么卖？”上班族女人又问。
“店里的普通仓鼠，根据品种，价格在50-200元之间，而宠物展示区的仓鼠，价格在原有的基础上，统一增加五百元。”沐游说。
“差这么多？”
上班族女人忍不住皱眉，其他人也是纷纷吃惊。
同样是仓鼠，这价格差距未免太大了吧？最低的和最高的竟差了有十倍之多！
沐游似乎早已料到会有这么一问，淡定解释道：“因为宠物展示区的仓鼠都是经过了专业训练的，可以直接听懂人的命令，省去了买主训练的时间。要知道仓鼠这种低智力的小动物，养宠新手自己训练的话，要消耗大量的时间和精力，而且效果无法保证。这多出来的500元，属于训练费用。”
“如果诸位对这个价格有疑虑的话，可以上网查一下训练宠物的费用，我这个绝对不算贵，而且效果也绝不比普通的训宠师差。”
听他这么一说，众人都是急忙翻出手机搜索了起来。
“哇，网上说训练一只猫狗就要好几千呢，真的假的？”
“好像是真的，我听我同学说过，她家的狗找训犬师训练了一个月，花了小一万呢，而且最后还没训好……”
“我都不知道，训练宠物原来这么赚钱啊！”
“能找到的基本都是训练猫狗的，仓鼠这种小动物肯定更难训练……”
几个女生凑在一起嘀嘀咕咕讨论着。

和网上的价格比起来，这家店的要价简直太良心了，而且这训练效果有目共睹，不存在花了钱却训练失败的可能。
“老板，我要买这只。”
刚才那个上班族女人果断挑选了十七旁边的一只仓鼠。
“好，这只仓鼠品种是金丝熊，价格550元。不过如果你是初次养宠，我建议你将笼子浴沙木屑饲料饮水器等必备用品一次买齐，现在店里有活动，打包购买一整套的宠物用具，可享受八折优惠。”
女人一想也是，光买只仓鼠回去能做什么？这家店老板看起来还是比较良心的，与其之后再去淘宝，还不如就在这儿一块买齐了。
“那行，我不是太懂这个，你看看必要的用品都给我来一份儿吧。”
“没问题，小雅，你带客人去挑选。”沐游朝那边的小雅打了个招呼。
小雅立即会意，急忙招呼着顾客往宠物用品区走，同时热情的介绍起了各种用品的作用。
小雅口才不错，而这客人也算是不差钱的那种，各种用品基本全选的是高级货色。
一番挑选下来，各种宠物用品快要在她面前堆成了小山，而光这一个客人的消费，就达到了1000+。
将饲料，浴沙等大小件一起打包到箱子里，最后小雅还贴心的送上了一份厚厚的《仓鼠饲养手册》。
这手册是当初沐游的父母亲手编写的，内容绝对都是干货。
其他人一看，打包了这么大一箱子东西，价格却也没有很贵，而且还有这么厚的一本养宠攻略赠送，顿时都没了犹豫，争先恐后的开口。
“老板，这只我要了！”
“那我要这只！”
“给我也来一只！”
四只仓鼠，很快就别瓜分完毕。
其他人一看仓鼠瞬间就被抢完，都有些懊恼，却无可奈何，总不能厚着脸皮跟人家已经说好的去争抢吧？只好赶忙将目光放到宠物展示区的其它宠物上，生怕这些也被人抢光。
店里一改往日的冷清，变得哄闹一片。
小雅忙前忙后招呼着客人，脸上却满是笑容，宠物店重新红火了起来，她比谁都高兴。

很快，十只训练过的宠物便全部卖了出去。
至于普通区的宠物，倒是也有几个买的，但明显大多数人兴趣不高。这些宠物呆头呆脑的，比起那些训练过的，差距不是一点半点。
倒是有几个机灵的顾客主动凑到沐游身边，询问什么时候再能有训练好的动物出售。
“我每天都会训练宠物，但训练周期会比较长，各位有需求的话，可以每天都来看看，当然，我们这里也接受预定。”沐游说。
一听他这么说，那些还没买的客人纷纷留了电话，预定了一只到两只的宠物。
在看好的宠物笼子上贴上姓名标签后，不少人就直接离开，店内客人一下少了许多，剩下的那些，小雅一个人就足以招呼过来。
沐游反而闲来了下来。
在楼下转了两圈，确认没自己什么事后，他索性回了二楼房间。
关上屋门，掏出手机，《愚者》启动！
昨天一系列的收获，让他现在对这个游戏相当期待。
content_en:
As expected, as soon as everyone entered the store, they all gathered in front of a hamster's cage in the pet display area.
The protagonist surrounded by them is, of course, the little hamster Shiqi who appeared in the video yesterday.
"This is the hamster in yesterday's video!"
"It must be, I remember this coat color."
"Little hamster, do some push-ups!"
Someone impatiently issued an order.
After hearing the instruction, the little hamster reluctantly laid its two front legs on the side of the cage, pressed down, and made a less than standard push-up action.
This enthusiasm is much worse than when the video was taken yesterday, but even so, it immediately triggered all kinds of screams.
"Wow, it's really like in the video, I can understand people's words!"
"This is too cute!"
"Little hamster, go run a few laps!"
"Turn around and see!"
"Lie down and play dead!"
Then everyone immediately started chirping and making various other orders.
As a result, the hamster ignored him and just lay beside the cage, stretching out his paws to make begging gestures.
Everyone looked a little confused at first.
Until someone realized something and tried to stuff a peanut into his hand. The little hamster decisively stuffed the peanut into his cheek, and then continued to execute the command of running the wheel.
Everyone suddenly realized that they were asking for food before they were willing to give the next order!
However, instead of being annoying, the behavior of this kind of power captured the hearts of all the women present: They also know how to ask for something in return, which is a sign of intelligence!
"It's so lovely!"
"I feel smarter than in the video!"
"How could there be such a cute hamster!"
"Boss, how do you sell this hamster?"
Everyone praised him one after another, and soon some people couldn't hold on any longer.
A woman dressed as an office worker took the lead in asking Mu You about the price.
"Sorry, this hamster is not for sale, but you can buy several other hamsters in the display area. They have also been trained and, like Seventeen, can understand most of the commands." Mu Youyou said.
As the protagonist in yesterday's video, Shiqi has the potential to become an internet celebrity. Muyou certainly won't be stupid enough to sell it directly. It is obviously more appropriate to keep him in the store as a sign.
"How do you sell other hamsters?" the office woman asked again.
"Ordinary hamsters in the store are priced between 50-200 yuan depending on the species, while the price of hamsters in the pet display area will be increased by 500 yuan based on the original price." Mu Youyou.
"So much difference?"
The office woman couldn't help but frown, and the others were also surprised.
They are both hamsters, so the price difference is too big, right? The difference between the lowest and the highest is ten times!
Mu You seemed to have expected such a question, and calmly explained: "Because the hamsters in the pet display area have been professionally trained, they can directly understand human commands, saving buyers time for training. You must know that hamsters are small animals with low intelligence. If novice pet owners train them by themselves, it will consume a lot of time and energy, and the effect cannot be guaranteed. The extra 500 yuan is a training fee."
"If you have any doubts about the price, you can check the cost of pet training online. Mine is definitely not expensive, and the effect is no worse than that of ordinary pet trainers."
After hearing what he said, everyone hurriedly took out their mobile phones and started searching.
"Wow, it is said online that training a cat or dog costs several thousand. Is this true?"
"It seems to be true. I heard my classmate say that her dog was trained by a dog trainer for a month, which cost less than 10,000 yuan, and in the end it was not trained well..."
"I didn't know it was so profitable to train pets!"
"The ones you can find are basically for training cats and dogs. Small animals like hamsters are definitely more difficult to train..."
Several girls gathered together and discussed in whispers.
Compared with the prices online, the prices in this store are higherThe price is so good, and the training effect is obvious to all. There is no possibility of failure in training after spending money.
"Boss, I want to buy this one."
The office woman just now decisively picked a hamster next to Shi Qi.
"Okay, this hamster is a golden bear, and the price is 550 yuan. But if you are raising a pet for the first time, I suggest you buy all the necessary supplies such as cage, sand, sawdust, feed, water fountain, etc. at once. There is an event in the store right now. If you buy a complete set of pet equipment in a package, you can enjoy a 20% discount."
The woman thought the same thing, what can she do if she just buys a hamster? The owner of this store seems to be quite conscientious. Instead of going to Taobao later, he might as well buy everything here.
"Okay, I don't know much about this. Just take a look at the necessary supplies and bring me some."
"No problem, Xiaoya, you take the guests to choose." Mu You greeted Xiaoya over there.
Xiaoya understood immediately and hurriedly greeted the customer to the pet supplies area, while enthusiastically introducing various supplies.
Xiaoya is very eloquent, and this customer is not short of money. Basically all the supplies are high-end.
After some selection, all kinds of pet supplies almost piled up in front of her, and the consumption of this one customer alone reached 1,000+.
Packing the feed, bath sand and other large and small items together into the box, Xiaoya also thoughtfully presented a thick "Hamster Breeding Manual" at the end.
This manual was written by Muyou's parents, and the content is absolutely full of useful information.
When the others saw that such a large box of things was packed, but the price was not very expensive, and there was also such a thick pet-raising guide as a gift, they immediately stopped hesitating and rushed to speak.
"Boss, I want this one!"
"Then I want this one!"
"Give me one too!"
The four hamsters will soon be divided up.
When the others saw that all the hamsters were snatched up in an instant, they were a little annoyed, but there was nothing they could do. They couldn't be so shameless as to fight for them as they had already agreed, right? I had to quickly turn my attention to the other pets in the pet display area, for fear that these would also be snatched up.
The store changed from its usual deserted state to a noisy one.
Xiaoya was busy greeting customers, but her face was full of smiles. The pet shop became prosperous again, and she was happier than anyone else.
Soon, all ten trained pets were sold.
As for the pets in the general area, there were a few who bought them, but it was obvious that most people were not very interested. These pets are stupid, and there is no slight difference compared to those that have been trained.
However, a few smart customers approached Mu You and asked when they would have trained animals for sale again.
"I train pets every day, but the training cycle will be relatively long. If you need it, you can come and see it every day. Of course, we also accept reservations here." Mu Youyou.
Upon hearing what he said, those customers who had not yet bought one all left their phone numbers and made reservations for one or two pets.
After putting name tags on the pet cages they were looking for, many people left directly. The number of customers in the store suddenly decreased, and Xiaoya alone could greet the remaining ones.
Instead, Mu You took some time to relax.
After walking around downstairs twice to make sure that nothing happened to him, he simply returned to his room on the second floor.
Close the door, take out your phone, and start "The Fool"!
A series of gains yesterday made him look forward to this game.
